reason: I've been moving shelves in my own stores for years and I can see what works on a weekend walk. Paying almost a million pesos a year to a new company with zero customer results so a computer can guess what my shoppers do? No.
objection: A simulation is not real shoppers. Why would I trust made-up people over what I see with my own eyes in my own aisles, especially from a company nobody has used yet?
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap pilot in two or three of my stores where their recommended layout actually beats my own arrangement in real POS sales over a couple of months.
